items.title: US signs landmark nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia
items.description: The US Department of Energy says the "peaceful" co-operation agreement will give US firms "great access" to the Saudi nuclear energy programme.

items.title: Houthis claim attack on oil tankers as US launches more strikes on Iran
items.description: The Houthi attacks would be the first in the Red Sea since the Iran-backed group announced a "maritime embargo" against Saudi Arabia.

items.title: Around 12,000 people evacuated in France fires
items.description: A third firefighter has died in Europe while tackling ongoing wildfires across the continent.

items.title: 'I am still alive': Indian activist on hunger strike for 26 days loses 11kg
items.description: Sonam Wangchuk has been the main draw at the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protest in Delhi.

items.title: Tankers make sharp U-turns after Houthi shipping threat
items.description: All of the ships were travelling to or from Saudi ports before changing course, ship-tracking data shows.

items.title: Canada's 'powerful' dairy sector is in Trump's trade crosshairs
items.description: Canada's dairy supply management system is in the spotlight after the US president singled it out as one of three main irritants used to justify new tariffs.

items.title: Russia's businesses under strain from Ukraine's attacks on Wildberries
items.description: Ukrainian drones have hit several retail warehouses belonging to Russia's biggest online retailer Wildberries in a matter of days.

items.title: Google burning through cash with spiralling AI costs
items.description: The company said earlier this year it expected to spend as much as $190bn on AI investments.

items.title: Fire kills 10 members of same family in Peru, police say
items.description:
Authorities are investigating the cause of the blaze in Lima as local media report
 it may have been arson.

items.title: British woman jailed for blackmail after accusing banker of rape in Hong Kong
items.description: Isabel Rose was convicted of trying to extort £100,000 from the UK banker and perverting the course of justice.

items.title: Wreckage of Pan Am plane that shaped aviation safety found 74 years on
items.description: The deaths of 52 people on the Clipper Endeavor led to the introduction of mandatory pre-flight safety briefings.

items.title: Mamdani backs off pledge to arrest Netanyahu citing lack of authority
items.description: The New York City mayor instead called on US authorities to act on International Criminal Court's arrest warrant against the Israeli prime minister.
